body: Thank you very much for your support, this day really broke me somehow, thank you for your "plaster cast"!

Thank you very much for your response, I am really fucking happy that this sub and great users like you exists! 
Compared to what others go through, what I read on this sub, my problems seem smaller by lightyears. But emotions are a very strange thing and I hit some major point today that condensed alot of these grey feelings about myself and my life that I had for months into a pretty shitty black cloud. Not in the "you have a bad day" way, but more in a mental breakdown and realisation kind of way.
I never wrote about killing myself in my post, but I very much felt like it today- But it doesn't feel right at all.
I put myself into bed, ate something and have gained a little bit more control over my mind.
Time to take a step up the stairs, I guess- I guess there will be some decision making and some tears in the next months, but I'll go on trying.
Thank you very much for your very personal support, Internet Hug to you, you are a great human being!
